a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both dead. Operating twice gives under a 4% chance of surviving long enough to take. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather propose another arrangement, tell me. I'll give back any cells beyond 4 if the episode continues.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. Sorry, I know this breaks our agreement. I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can build back toward 4 for you. If anything goes above 4 in my unit, I'll give it back.
